title: Heavy Blueprint tick or VM script execution
fix_rationale: Blueprint tick costs can be mitigated by disabling unused ticks, reducing tick intervals, or moving tight calculation loops to C++.
evidence_template: {timer} spent {ms} ms executing Blueprint bytecode across game actors ({share}% of excess time).

fixes.text: Disable 'Start with Tick Enabled' on actors/components that do not need continuous updates; switch to event-driven logic or timers.
Increase Tick Interval (e.g. SetActorTickInterval(0.1)) for non-critical gameplay updates.
Profile specific Blueprint graphs and nativize or rewrite math-heavy loops in C++.

verify: Re-run profile and confirm that ProcessEvent and ExecuteUbergraph times drop significantly.
